title: Longtail Failure Fusion & Rollback Codex
author: Marisol Chen
content:
Summary

This codex describes a prescriptive, reproducible procedure for fusing longtail failure signals across the eval harness, production shadow runs, prompt/embedding drift detectors, and quantization compatibility telemetry to reach an operational rollback decision. The document synthesizes rules for signal weighting, minimum evidence requirements, automated and manual rollback triggers, and post-rollback verification steps. It is intended for oncall engineers, applied-ML owners, and SREs who participate in regression triage.

Scope

- Applies to model-serving regressions (hosted/dedicated/private) impacting: generation coherency, functioncall correctness, embedding stability, semantic drift, and major cost anomalies caused by quant migrations.
- Excludes: single-request infra failures (network flaps), transient infra-only node failures covered by infra runbooks.

Primary owners and run participants

- Primary owner: Model Reliability (eng) — contact: @marisol.chen
- Triage coordinator: oncall-applied-ml
- SRE partner: oncall-sre
- Notify: product-owners for services with >10% user impact or revenue-path customers.

Signals and authoritative data sources

1) Eval Harness (eval-mesh)
   - Key metrics: fidelity_delta (Fdelta), response_stability_index (RSI), slice_failure_rate (SFR)
   - Data latency: 2–10 minutes for continuous probes, batch horizon 1–4 hours

2) Shadow / Shadow-orchestrator
   - Key metrics: live_regression_score (LRS), percentile disagreement (pDisag), functioncall-failures per 1000 (FC_1k)
   - Config: shadow cohorts must reflect the affected tenant mix; see section "Shadow cohort hygiene"

3) Telemetry from Runtime (probe-farm, kv-cache-trace)
   - Key metrics: kvcache_miss_rate, tokenization_anomalies, tail_latency_p99

4) Quant path and artifact health (quant-scheduler)
   - Key metrics: quant_loss_proxy (QLP), quant-round-trip-error (QRTE), observed compression ratio (CR)

5) Customer / Canary feedback (customer-reported defects, canary errors)
   - Structured via support tickets tagged regression-triage and in Slack channel #regressions-ops

Fusion rules (how signals are combined)

Principle: prefer signal breadth over depth for longtail regressions — a weak signal across many orthogonal sources is more actionable than a single strong metric from a brittle probe.

Evidence model (numeric weights):

||Signal source||Typical weight||Minimum sample size||
|Eval Harness (slice-anchored)|0.30|>= 50 probes per slice|
|Shadow (live)|0.28|>= 1000 requests in cohort|
|Runtime telemetry|0.18|>= 5000 tokens across traces|
|Quant artifact|0.14|>= 3 model variants tested|
|Customer reports|0.10|>= 2 independent tickets|

Scoring formula (operational):

- For each signal compute a normalized anomaly score in [0,1] where 0 = no anomaly and 1 = severe. (Normalization procedure is documented in Appendix A.)
- Fusion score = sum(weight_i * normalized_score_i).
- Action thresholds:
  - Fusion score < 0.25: Monitor. Open triage ticket but no rollback.
  - 0.25 <= Fusion score < 0.50: Elevated investigation. Consider targeted canary/patch.
  - Fusion score >= 0.50: Strong candidate for rollback or traffic re-routing. Proceed to rollback runbook.

Minimum evidence gates (hard requirements before automated rollback)

1) Shadow-orchestrator cohort must show pDisag >= 0.12 AND LRS >= 0.35 for the affected slice, or
2) Eval-mesh fidelity_delta >= 0.18 on at least two orthogonal slices (e.g., intent-slice + functioncall-slice), or
3) Quant-loss-proxy > 0.20 AND QRTE producing >1% top-k misrank compared to baseline.

If none of the minimum gates are satisfied, rollback should not be automated. Manual rollback is allowed with oncall + model-owner approval (see manual approval checklist).

Automated rollback triggers (when CI/CD integration permitted)

- A scheduled anomaly aggregator service (regression-blender) will compute fusion scores every 5 minutes. If fusion score >= 0.60 AND at least one minimum evidence gate is true, trigger automated rollback preflight (not final rollback):
  1. Open an incident ticket with pre-filled diagnostics and a pre-rollback plan.
  2. Run targeted canary unroute to baseline for 5% of traffic for 10 minutes.
  3. If the canary unroute reduces fusion score by >= 50%, proceed to full rollback. Else escalate to manual triage.

Manual rollback decision checklist

- Required participants: oncall-applied-ml, model-owner, oncall-sre.
- Checklist items (all must be considered; at least 4/6 must be positive to proceed):
  1. Does the fusion score >= 0.50? (Yes/No)
  2. Is there corroborating customer impact (support tickets or telemetry)?
  3. Can a partial rollback (per-region or per-tenant) reduce risk to observability?
  4. Has a quant migration been applied recently to this model build?
  5. Are there known infra anomalies that could confound signals?
  6. Has the baseline passed the same evaluation probes within the last 24 hours?

Rollback runbook (step-by-step)

1) Pre-rollback: Verify signals and capture a debug snapshot
   - Execute: rwd-eval query --slice <slice-name> --window 60m --format json > /tmp/slice_snapshot.json
   - Run: rwd-shadow snapshot --cohort <cohort-id> --duration 10m --out /tmp/shadow_snapshot.json

2) Partial mitigation (fast path, recommended)
   - Option A (routing): Reduce traffic to the suspect model by 30% for 10 minutes via traffic-router:
     traffic-router scale --model <model-id> --percent-decrease 30 --duration 10m --reason "regression-fusion"
   - Option B (fallback): Enable functioncall-strict-fallback policy:
     rwd-config set routing.fallback_policy functioncall_strict --enable true --ttl 600

3) Full rollback (if indicated)
   - Promote previous stable model version: rwd-deploy promote --model <model-id> --version <baseline-version> --force --annot "auto-rollback-fusion"
   - Verify: wait until rwd-deploy status --model <model-id> shows all pods at Ready and new baseline traffic distribution >= 95%

4) Post-rollback verification (10m, 30m, 2h checks)
   - Run the same eval probes used in the detection path and compare Fdelta/RSI. Expect fusion score drop >= 0.5 within 30 minutes.
   - Confirm p99 latency, kvcache_miss_rate and error budget consumption back to baseline.

Communication and stakeholders

- Triage ticket template must include: fusion_score, per-signal normalized values, top 3 affected slices, example failing probes (id + text), and snapshot links. Use the incident template /templates/regression-codex.md
- Slack: post initial alert to #regressions-ops and tag @model-owner and @sre-oncall.
- Customer-facing comms: if impacted tenants >10% or revenue-path customers affected, follow the customer comms playbook and notify CS within 30 minutes.

Postmortem and blameless analysis

- If rollback occurred, open postmortem within 48 hours. Include: root-cause hypothesis, probe artifacts, quant artifacts (if applicable), and timeline with fusion_score and per-signal graphs.
- Add remediation actions to the Regression Debt backlog and assign owners.

Example incident (short walkthrough)

- Timeline:
  - 01:10: regression-blender fusion_score = 0.62 (quant QLP 0.22, shadow LRS 0.4, RSI 0.25)
  - 01:15: automated preflight reduces suspect model traffic by 5% -> fusion drops to 0.58
  - 01:25: canary unroute 10% traffic -> fusion drops to 0.28 -> rollback promoted baseline at 01:40
  - 02:15: all verification probes show expected RSI improvement, postmortem opened.

Appendix A — Normalizing signals (procedure)

1) For each metric compute z-score using rolling 30-day mean and std. Convert z to a sigmoid-normalized score in [0,1] with scaling tuned per metric.
2) Clip outliers at 99.9 percentile to avoid single-probe domination.

Appendix B — Sample config snippets

- Eval probe registration (example YAML):
  ---
  probe_name: "functioncall-critical-anchored"
  slices: ["functioncall", "finance-instruction"]
  frequency: 5m
  min_samples: 50
  acceptance_criteria:
    - metric: fidelity_delta
      threshold: 0.12

- Regression blender config (JSON-like):
  {
    "fusion_weights": {
      "eval_mesh": 0.30,
      "shadow": 0.28,
      "runtime": 0.18,
      "quant": 0.14,
      "customer": 0.10
    },
    "fusion_interval_seconds": 300,
    "automated_preflight": {
      "canary_percent": 5,
      "canary_duration_secs": 600,
      "rollback_threshold": 0.5
    }
  }

Appendix C — Quick CLI checklist for oncall

- Capture snapshots:
  rwd-eval query --slice <slice> --window 60m --format json > /tmp/snap.json
  rwd-shadow snapshot --cohort <cohort> --duration 10m --out /tmp/shadow.json
- Check fusion score:
  rwd-blender score --model <model-id> --window 15m
- Trigger partial traffic reduction (manual):
  traffic-router scale --model <model-id> --percent-decrease 30 --duration 10m --reason "manual-triage"
